transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, it's a burning when I pass water, and I'm needing to go much more often than usual. It started about four days ago and it's getting a bit wearing.
Have you ever had an allergy or a bad reaction to any medicine?
Yes, I'm allergic to trimethoprim — it gave me an itchy rash.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment?

Yes, I take levothyroxine 75 micrograms each morning, and alendronic acid 70 mg once a week for my thin bones. I also use a vaginal cream from the hospital twice a week, but I can't remember its name.
Besides the burning when you pass water and needing to go more often, have you noticed anything else that's bothering you?

The urine looks cloudy and smells stronger than usual, but I haven't seen any blood. I'm going about every hour during the day and getting up three or four times at night, when I usually only get up once.
Where do you feel the burning when you pass water?
It's a stinging feeling as the water comes out — I'd say about 5 out of 10, uncomfortable but I'm managing. I can't say I've really noted exactly where it is.
Is there anything you've noticed that makes the burning or the need to pass water better or worse?
No, I can't say I've noticed anything that makes it better or worse.
Other than the thin bones you mentioned, is there anything else about your past health—like other health problems, operations, or hospital stays—that you’d like to add?
I've got an underactive thyroid, and I had a water infection about a year ago that was treated with antibiotics.
What's been worrying you most about all of this?

I think it's another water infection, like the one I had last year, and I'm hoping to get antibiotics before the weekend. I've stopped going to the residents' coffee morning in case I can't reach a toilet in time, and that's bothering me.
Is there anything else about your past health that you'd like to add?
No, I don't think there's anything else.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about the medicines you take, including any new or recently changed ones?
No, I don't think so — those are the only medicines I take, and nothing new or changed recently.
Have you noticed anything else going on since this started, other than what you've already told me?
No, I haven't had any fever, shivers, or back or side pain, and my niece hasn't noticed any confusion in me. That's about it.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
